usage: Used for a person who works at the front desk of a company, hotel, clinic, or office and greets visitors.
Common in formal or workplace settings; more natural than casual everyday speech.
Often appears with places like reception desk, office, hotel, clinic, or company; you can also say a specific role, such as front-desk receptionist.
For learners, this is a countable job noun, so it can take measure words and be used with verbs like work as, hire, or ask for.
